# Acme Storage: price list

Saved copy of the vendor's own price page, as published. Effective 1 March 2026.

## Storage
| Tier | Price |
|---|---|
| Standard | $0.021 per GB-month |
| Archive | $0.004 per GB-month (minimum 90 days) |

## Data transfer out (egress)
The first 100 GB of egress each month is free. After that, egress costs $0.05 per GB.

## Requests
Reads are free on every tier. Writes cost $0.40 per million on Standard and $5.00 per million on Archive.

Prices change only with 30 days' notice on this page.
